title: M8b loot and death drops — isolated packet
purpose: Implement exact battle loot using one death dispatcher shared safely with progression.
task: Author source code and tests for §8.8: battle-start spawn table, marine death gun+parts table, variable parts pickups and HUD comparison, plus T14 forced-chance integration.

in: On hostile SM_Marine death, independent gun drop probability 35%; tier weapon table Conscript Kar98k|Luger, Regular Kar98k|MP40, Veteran MP40|StG44, Elite StG44, magazine randomized from 0 through MagSize; all hostile non-FL_SoldierGER are Regular.
Parts chance 30% plus 15% per Scavenger rank (as defined in §5), 1–2 parts; ensure FL_PartsPickup represents amounts 1 or 2 while starting TID-160 pickup grants exactly 2.
Battle start TID-160 50% FL_PartsPickup(2), 25% Doom ClipBox, 25% nothing. Reuse existing Handler.PlaceLoot rather than spawning twice.
Keep existing nearest-ownerless FL_Weapon ≤96 HUD comparison, every 10 tics, including hands-full/J-to-drop; propose only minimal correction if spec demands.

Implement T14 with exactly 20 German kills and production death hooks at forced 100% gun-drop chance, then count exactly 20 spawned ownerless gun pickups. Never claim PASS from counters or test-only directly spawned guns.
out: Shop, workbench, roster purchases, class/skill logic, M7, package changes, duplicate kill XP awards or donor edits.

constraints: Use only the specifically supplied source files. source_001_FRONTLINE44_SPEC.md controls, including the approved §8.6 debut reservation. Distinguish verified source facts from untested engine hypotheses.

Parallel source authoring only; the operator alone integrates in M7→M8→M9→M10 order, repairs compiler/API faults, runs the engine, accepts milestones and ships. No engine is assumed available to this call; never claim that load or any test PASS was executed.

ZScript only for gameplay; all custom files under frontline/; no donor code modifications; FL_ custom class prefix and fl_ CVar prefix; every newly introduced production number other than 0/1 must be declared in FL_T. Do not weaken tests or change existing PASS semantics.

Preserve M0–M6 baselines and T1–T11/T13 arg0/T16; no whole-file Handler.zs, Tests.zs, Tuning.zs, zscript.zs, mapinfo.txt or keyconf.txt rewrites. A parallel implementation must provide method-only fragments and a machine-readable hooks.json for operator application.

Frozen-source status conflict: source_002 claims M6/T10 PASS while source_012 records T10 FAIL and source_016 was an unrun proposal. Treat current M6 verification as an operator preflight gate, not a proved PASS; never change director economics within this job.

Result is inert code; report unverified ZScript signature assumptions as PARTIAL/BLOCKED and provide diagnostics. Do not silently add game features, implement test-only cheats, relax thresholds or edit donor code.

Exclusive existing editable path: frontline/zscript/fl/Items.zs ONLY; supply complete preserved-file replacement + unified diff if variable-size FL_PartsPickup needs changes. No change to existing 999999 caps or 10 skill classes.
Single Handler.WorldThingDied override is integrator-owned: Call 2 M8A_OnDeath(e) runs first, then Call 3 M8L_OnDeath(e); do not define an override in Call 3 output.

Integrator replaces only Handler.PlaceLoot method body (existing WorldLoaded call already executes it) and optionally UpdateLoot body if strictly needed; T14 setup/tick hooks are added to existing Tests.WorldLoaded and WorldTick.
T14 forced drop probability must only operate under fl_selftest==14; normal battle uses 35%, part probabilities remain correct and no donor SM_Marine automatic drop is miscounted.

All 0–1 and greater constants (loot rates, target count, tier tables, range, tick interval, gun class mapping, part yields) must use FL_T tables/constants with no new nonzero magic numbers outside Tuning.
